fields.System.Title: FDN-607 — Freeze fields once stock exists
fields.System.Description:
Story

As a developer, I want certain product fields to become uneditable once stock exists, so
that a change cannot silently alter what every existing balance means.

Acceptance criteria

  • - Given a product with stock, when I change case_quantity, base_uom,
  • requires_batch, or requires_serial, then it is rejected with an explanation.
  • - Given a product with no stock and no history, then those fields can be changed.
  • - Given a product with stock, then description, barcodes, and non-frozen physical
  • attributes can still be changed.
  • - Given a change to the SKU, then it is allowed and an alias record is kept so old codes
  • still resolve.
  • - Given an ERP master data update touching a frozen field, then it is rejected and
  • reported rather than applied.

Traceability

| Aspect | Detail |
|---|---|
| Modules | masterdata |
| Tables | product |
| Risks | Frozen field changed while stock exists ([doc 03 §5](../../../docs/03-master-data.md)); historical data reinterpreted ([doc 09 §11.6](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md)) |
| Tests | unit · integration |
